name: Adenine riboswitch bound to adenine
preparationNotes: All 5 Mg2+ ions (X:101-105) removed per benchmark ion policy. Single chain X RNA receptor. Adenine ligand ADE at X:90. Box 22x22x22 A centered on ligand centroid.
source: RCSB PDB 1Y26; Serganov et al. Cell 2004 doi:10.1016/j.cell.2004.11.020
affinitySource: Mandal M et al. Nat Struct Mol Biol 2003; Kd ~300 nM for adenine
affinityNotes: Adenine riboswitch from V. vulnificus addA mRNA. Kd ~300 nM for adenine. Highly selective: guanine and 2-aminopurine bind ~100x weaker. Companion to 1Y27 (guanine riboswitch, B. subtilis) — same fold, single-nucleotide pocket change switches adenine/guanine selectivity.
notes: add A-riboswitch from V. vulnificus. Adenine binds via Watson-Crick pairing with C74 (N1-N3, N6-O2 H-bonds). U48 and A23 form base-stacking sandwich above and below adenine. 2.10 A X-ray, best resolution among new cases.
